note: Recorded control-2 inputs from native x86_64 runs of the Percona proof, un-sabotaged, same candidate digest and runner image. Latencies are in seconds. 'worst' is each tenant's worst statement over the whole run, 'baseline' its worst statement before the first dump (as logged: the worst across rounds, which is what these runs recorded; the probe now judges round 1 only). The quiet run passed on main; the two noisy runs were slow shared runners whose own commit latency alone broke the 100 ms limit.
